name: inspect_baseline_snapshot_source
label: Source of the Snapshot for Inspection Configuration
description: The source of the inspection configuration snapshot can be used for time dimension statistical queries and association queries related to inspections.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: Snapshot ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: app_system_id
fields.description: Application ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: tag_id
fields.description: The ID of the tag. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_app
indexes.description: Standard index covering the app_system_id, app_module_id, env_id fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_tag_snapshot
indexes.description: Standard index covering the tag_id, snapshot_id fields, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_snapshot_tag
indexes.description: Unique index covering the snapshot_id, tag_id fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
